content: Root cause: The bug was caused by an issue with the cache management for host role command statuses in the Ambari server. Specifically, the cache was not being invalidated correctly when tasks were resubmitted or when hosts were removed, leading to stale data being used in the upgrade process. The patch addresses this by ensuring that the cache is invalidated at the appropriate times, particularly after tasks are resubmitted and when a host is removed, thus preventing the upgrade from getting stuck at a manual prompt due to incorrect status calculations.

buggy_stmts_infos.buggy_stmt: -    LOG.info("Invalidating command cache on host delete event." );
